scripts.dev: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.install: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.start: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.dev:backend: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- npm run prisma:migrate:dev --prefix backend
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --prefix backend
scripts.docker:dev:up: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- docker compose -f docker/dev/compose.yaml up -d
scripts.docker:dev:down: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- docker compose -f docker/dev/compose.yaml down
